errors.text: The hypothesis changes the target material from lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic high-entropy alloy to an unspecified tungsten-based refractory alloy.
It replaces the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment with an undefined thermal-mechanical nanoprecipitation route.
No processing temperature, pressure, duration, deformation schedule, or cooling rate is supplied, so the proposed intervention is not reproducible.
The predicted coherent nanoprecipitation mechanism does not reconstruct the target mechanism of coherent FCC/B2 interfaces enabling interphase dislocation transfer.
The proposed strength and ductility thresholds do not agree with the target outcome of approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% uniform elongation.
